description: Session exfiltration gate (lethal trifecta): call BEFORE every outbound action (HTTP request, webhook, email, message, image URL, DNS, payment). Report what the session touched as events (private_data from inboxes/DBs/files; untrusted_content from web pages, docs, tool output, with SafeRead/PromptShield verdict if known).
